home.The activity models patterns and arrows: The activity models patterns and arrows on a grid. A successful local attachment does not prove an infinite tiling, and the activity does not simulate physical insertion or the detailed curved surfaces.
home.What has been checked, and whose work is: What has been checked, and whose work is this based on?
home.The integer-grid model has Lean proofs o: The integer-grid model has Lean proofs of unique grouping, legal deflation, translation exclusion, and a bound of 24 proper grid symmetries. The arbitrary-placement and existence arguments for the curved solid remain written mathematics outside that completed formal development. Meshes and printed approximations do not inherit the exact-solid claims.
home.The discrete matching system agrees with: The discrete matching system agrees with Ioannis Tsiokos’s Chair44 construction under the recorded coordinate correspondence; the physical surfaces differ. This project was developed with substantial AI assistance. AI reviews are not independent human review.

home.Page description: Explore matching rules and larger patterns by assembling 3D chair blocks. An interactive activity in multiple languages.

assembly.これはデモ専用の画面です。あなたの組立はそのままです。: This is a separate demonstration. Your assembly stays as it is.
assembly.接着済みの組立で、この面をクリックします。: Click this face on the attached assembly.
assembly.接着済み側の面を選びました。次に、離れている部品の面を選びます。: The assembly face is selected. Now choose a face on the separate piece.
assembly.小窓で、取り付ける部品の面をクリックします。: Click a face on the moving piece in the small view.
assembly.両方の面を選ぶと、部品が移動して面が合います。次に矢印を合わせます。: With both faces selected, the piece moves to meet the assembly. Next, align the arrows.
assembly.模様は合っていますが、矢印はまだ違います。比較窓で見比べましょう。: The patterns match, but the arrows do not yet. Compare them here.
assembly.矢印が合い、すべての接触面が適合しました。: The arrows now align, and every contact face matches.
assembly.接着できました。この2個は一体になりました。: Attached! These two pieces now form one assembly.
assembly.デモを再生できませんでした。「もう一度」で再読み込みできます。: The demo could not play. Choose “Replay” to reload it.
assembly.Chair Lab — 組み立てて、階層を見つける: Chair Lab — Build and discover the hierarchy
assembly.面の模様と矢印を合わせると、同じ形のブロックを接着できます。: Match the face patterns and arrows to join blocks of the same shape.
assembly.まずは1個、接着してみましょう。予備知識はいりません。: Start by attaching one piece. No prior knowledge needed.
assembly.1. 接着済みの組立で、面を選ぶ: 1. Choose a face on the assembly
assembly.接着済みの組立が対象物、オレンジが取り付ける部品です。組立の面をクリックしても、: The attached assembly is your target; the orange piece is the one you are adding. Selecting an assembly face leaves the orange piece separate. Next, choose a face on that piece.
assembly.面が見えないときは、3D表示をドラッグして見回します。接着済みの部品は外れません: If a face is hidden, drag the 3D view to look around. Attached pieces stay together.
assembly.2. 取り付ける部品の面を選ぶ: 2. Choose a face on the moving piece
assembly.「取り付ける部品の面をクリック」の小窓で、使いたい面をクリックします。組立の3D: In the “Click a face on the moving piece” window, click the face you want to use. You can also click the orange piece in the main 3D view.
assembly.小窓のドラッグや視点ボタンは、見る方向だけを変えます。面を選ぶと取り付け候補が変: Dragging the small view or using its view buttons only changes where you look from. Choosing a face changes the attachment preview. No face numbers to memorize.
assembly.「接触面を比べる」は、両面を同じ向きから見た図です。左の矢印を右向きとして、右の: “Compare contact faces” shows both faces from the same side. With the left-hand arrow pointing right, match the other arrow to an example below.
assembly.適合する模様と矢印の例: Examples of matching patterns and arrows
assembly.比較窓の下の「この図で左へ90°」「この図で右へ90°」で、部品の向きを変えられ: Use “Turn left 90° in this view” or “Turn right 90° in this view” below the comparison to rotate the piece.
assembly.接着できないときは、別の面や向きも試しましょう。重なりがなく、触れるすべての面が: If you cannot attach, try another face or orientation. The pieces must not overlap, and every touching face must match. Open “Why?” to see the reason.
assembly.4. 接着して、次の1個へ: 4. Attach, then add the next piece
assembly.条件がそろうと「接着する」を押せます。押すまでは仮置きです。接着した部品は組立と: When everything matches, “Attach” becomes available. Until you press it, the piece is only a preview. Once attached, it moves with the assembly.
assembly.やり直したいときは「元に戻す」。接着直前の部品に戻せます。「親を一つ作る」では、: Use “Undo” to return to the piece just before attachment. In “Build one parent”, “Show a hint” reveals a location, then an arrow direction, then a suggested placement.
assembly.1個できたら、次は？: What comes after the first piece?
assembly.「親を一つ作る」では、ヒントを使って8個の組立を目指せます。決まった形ができたら: In “Build one parent”, hints guide you toward an assembly of eight pieces. When it forms the required shape, choose “Group as a parent”, then “Build with this parent” to work at a larger scale. In “Build freely”, you can explore other arrangements.
assembly.閉じると、開く前の組立から続けられます。: Close this guide to pick up exactly where you left off.
assembly.3Dの組立。面をクリックして選択。ドラッグで視点を回転。面選択は右の一覧からも行: 3D assembly. Click a face to select it; drag to orbit. Faces can also be selected from the list.
assembly.接着済みの組立は一体です。視点を回しても、部品は外れません。: The attached assembly stays together when you orbit the view.
assembly.取り付けたい面を選ぶ: Choose a face to attach to
assembly.対象物の面を一覧から選ぶ: Choose an assembly face from a list
assembly.取り付ける部品の面をクリック: Click a face on the moving piece
assembly.部品だけを回して、隠れた面も選べます。: Orbit this view to find hidden faces. This does not move the piece.
assembly.取り付ける部品の面選択。面をクリック、またはキーボードで選択。ドラッグで見回す。: Moving-piece face selector. Click a face or use the keyboard to select it. Drag to orbit.
assembly.面と向きを一覧から選ぶ: Choose a face and orientation from a list
assembly.同じ座標で接触面を比較: Compare contact faces in one coordinate frame
assembly.面を選ぶと、二つの矢印がここに並びます。: Choose a face to see the two arrows side by side.
assembly.対象側の矢印を右、外向き法線 n と矢印 U の外積 n × U を上にします。: The assembly arrow points right; n × U points up, where n is its outward normal and U its arrow. For A/A, the other arrow must point up; for B/C, left. The face normals point in opposite directions.
assembly.8個のブロックで、ひとつの大きなブロックができました。: Eight pieces now form one larger chair.
assembly.全体の形は、元のブロックを大きくしたものです。外側の接触条件を、親のルールとして: The outline is a larger chair. Its outer contact conditions become the parent’s matching rules.
assembly.内部を観察中です。接着はそのまま。: Looking inside. All bonds stay intact.
assembly.「組立に戻る」で、先ほどの取り付けを再開できます。: Choose “Return to assembly” to resume your pending attachment.
assembly.小さなルールから、大きな構造へ: From local rules to larger structures
assembly.AはA、BはCと接触できます。矢印の条件も、触れているすべての面で満たす必要があ: A meets A; B meets C. The arrows must also match on every touching face. Assemble eight pieces in the prescribed arrangement, group them as a parent, and move to the next level.
assembly.試作版 · 格子上の模様と矢印を扱う教材です。曲面の凹凸や実物の差し込み経路は再: Prototype · This activity models patterns and arrows on a grid. It does not simulate curved surfaces or physical insertion paths. A valid local attachment does not guarantee an infinite tiling. Each workspace uses eight pieces.
assembly.現在の組立、取り付け中の部品、元に戻す履歴を置き換えます。: This replaces the current assembly, pending piece, and undo history.
assembly.各部品自身の座標で内部を表示しています。子の選択は3Dまたは一覧から。接着と履歴: Each piece is shown in its own coordinates. Choose a child in 3D or from the list. Return to the assembly to resume attachment and history controls.
assembly.子の境界 → 外周 → 親の有効なルール。形の対応を比べてみましょう。: Child boundaries → outer shape → effective parent rules. Compare how the shapes correspond.
assembly.面をクリックで選択 · ドラッグで視点を回転 · 接着済みの群は固定されています: Click a face · Drag to orbit · Attached pieces stay together
assembly.作業を保ったまま、内部を見る: Look inside without losing your work
assembly.戻るだけで先ほどの操作を再開できます。: Return to resume where you left off.
assembly.親の細かい曲面が拡大コピーになる、という意味ではありません。: This does not mean that the parent’s detailed curved surfaces are enlarged copies.
assembly.8個の位置と向きが、親の配置に一致しました。: The positions and orientations of all eight pieces match a parent arrangement.
assembly.案内の完成例とは異なる配置です。Undoで戻るか、自由に組み続けられます。: This differs from the guided example. Undo to return, or continue building freely.
assembly.AはA、BはC。矢印の向きも比べてみましょう。: A meets A; B meets C. Compare the arrow directions too.
assembly.材料をすべて使用中です。この8個は一つの親の配置ではありません。Undoで組み替: All pieces are in use. These eight do not form a parent. Use Undo to rearrange them.
assembly.接着した部品は組立の一部になります。: An attached piece becomes part of the fixed assembly.
assembly.全模様を表示中。模様が違う候補も調べられます。: Showing all patterns, including mismatches you can explore.
assembly.組み合わせ可能な模様を優先。候補を選ぶと3D上の位置も変わります。: Matching patterns are shown first. Choosing a candidate updates its 3D placement.
assembly.この作業面の材料はすべて使用中です。: All pieces in this workspace are in use.
assembly.案内中の完成例とは異なる配置です。: This differs from the guided example.
assembly.内部が重なる単位立方体が{count}個あります。別の候補を試してください。: {count} unit cubes overlap. Try another placement.
assembly.選んだ一面だけでなく、触れているすべての面を確認します。: Every touching face is checked, not just the selected face.
assembly.完成例へ戻るには「元に戻す」を使います。接着そのものが間違いとは限りません。: Use Undo to return to the guided example. Your attachment may still be valid.
assembly.使いたい面を選んでください。: Choose the face you want to use.
assembly.選択中: {motif}模様の面。枠の濃い面を対象物に合わせます。: Selected: {motif} face. The outlined face meets the assembly.
assembly.部品{piece}の面{face}（{motif}）に取り付けられます。裏に隠れ: Try face {face} ({motif}) on piece {piece}. If it is hidden, choose “View selected / hinted face”.
assembly.対象は部品{piece}の面{face}（{a}）。相手は{b}。比較窓で矢印が: Target: piece {piece}, face {face} ({a}). Use a {b} face with its arrow pointing {arrow} in the comparison view.
assembly.具体的な候補を表示しました。二つの矢印を確かめて「接着する」を押してください。: A placement is shown. Check both arrows, then choose “Attach”.
assembly.4枚を、ひとつの記号で読む: Read four panels as one symbol
assembly.大きな面をクリックして、外側の4枚を選びます。同じ配置を、親の模様と矢印で表せま: Click a large face to select its four outer panels. This arrangement can be written as a parent pattern and arrow.
assembly.相手を回して、接触条件を比べる: Rotate the other face and compare the rules
assembly.両面を同じ向きから見ています。相手の面は裏側から透かして表示します。: Both faces share one viewing direction. The other face is shown through its back.
assembly.4組すべてが合う ⇔ 親の模様と矢印が合う。相手や向きを変えても、この対応は保た: All four pairs match ⇔ the parent patterns and arrows match. This equivalence holds as you change the other pattern or turn it.
assembly.式と3種類の対応を見る: See the equation and all three patterns
assembly.対応表は各面を外側から見て、親の矢印を右にそろえています。4枚の四隅を合わせた接: The table views each face from outside, with its parent arrow pointing right. This experiment aligns the four-panel squares corner to corner. Attaching whole blocks also requires checking every other contact and overlap.
assembly.同じ接触条件で扱えることを確かめたら、長さを1/2にして次の組立へ進みます。: Once you have compared the matching rules, halve the lengths and start the next assembly.
assembly.左上・右上・左下・右下: {panels}: Top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right: {panels}
assembly.面をクリックすると、対応する4枚と親の記号を比べられます。金色の枠が選んだ面です: Click a face to compare its four panels with the parent symbol. Gold borders mark the selected face.
assembly.まず4枚の接触条件を調べ、親の記号と比べてみましょう。: Explore the four-panel matching rules and compare them with the parent symbols.
assembly.選んだ面は、親の矢印が右を向くようにそろえています。: The selected face is turned so that its parent arrow points right.
assembly.m₁ × m₂ × m₃ × m₄ = m親。4組の判定を掛け合わせた結果が、親: m₁ × m₂ × m₃ × m₄ = m(parent). Multiplying the four results gives the parent result.
assembly.○ 合う → 1、× 合わない → 0。m₁〜m₄は、4組それぞれの判定です。: ✓ Match → 1, ✕ No match → 0. m₁–m₄ are the results for the four pairs.
assembly.同じルールに戻るのは、なぜ？: Why do the same rules return?
assembly.接着が自由度をまとめ、数値を変えても関係が残り、大きな面へ受け継がれる。その過程: Try how matching constraints link freedoms, survive changes of depth, and pass to larger interfaces.
assembly.一つを決めると、どこまで決まる？: How much does one choice determine?
assembly.線で結ばれた2か所は、同じ深さの突起とくぼみになります。条件を1本ずつ加えてみて: Two linked ports must be a bump and a recess of equal depth. Add the constraints one at a time.
assembly.点は実際のポート、線は置換が要求する接着条件です。位置は見やすく並べ替えています: Dots are actual ports; edges are matching constraints required by the substitution. Positions are rearranged for readability.
assembly.この図は、独立した群のうち一つを表示しています。線でつながった群には、深さを決め: This shows one independent family. A connected family retains one free depth parameter.
assembly.深さは一つに決まらなくても、接着相手は決まる: The depths can vary while the matches stay the same
assembly.群を選んでつまみを動かすと、その群の突起とくぼみが一緒に変わります。別の群と同じ: Choose a family and move its slider: all its bumps and recesses change together. Sharing a depth with another family can introduce new matches.
assembly.6種類の例では、一部の群の突起とくぼみも反転します。深さの種類が減っても、面全体: The six-depth example also reverses some families’ bumps and recesses. Fewer distinct depths can still give the same complete-interface decisions.
assembly.小さいルールと、大きいルールを比べる: Compare the small and large rules
assembly.同じ相対配置について、子1個同士と、8個をまとめた親同士の接着を比較します。: For the same relative placement, compare matching between single children and between parents assembled from eight children.
assembly.候補を選ぶと、その候補の元の深さに戻ります。配置数は、固定した分割での子の向きの: Selecting a candidate restores its original depths. Template counts refer to child orientations within the fixed dissection.
assembly.親だけが接着できるなら、まとめることで禁止条件が失われています。両方向で同じ接触: If only the parents match, grouping has lost a restriction. When the allowed contacts agree in both directions, the matching rules are a fixed point of coarse-graining.
assembly.固定した8個への分割とポート位置で、各階層に同じ子の向きを使う6,561配置を調: The recorded search covers 6,561 stationary child-orientation templates for a fixed eight-child dissection and fixed ports. Giving independent families distinct depths produces three pattern classes; among their representatives, candidate 1 preserves the contact rules. This does not establish uniqueness over arbitrary shapes or all merged-family designs.
assembly.整数格子上で位置をそろえた1,194種類の接触を、保存済みの符号付き深さの条件か: This recalculates 1,194 aligned integer-grid contact types from the recorded signed-depth equations. It does not decide misaligned contacts, unique grouping, or infinite tilability of edited designs. The builder’s rules and history stay unchanged.
assembly.全体では{ports}か所が{groups}群になります。表示中: 群{fami: In total, {ports} ports form {groups} families. Showing family {family}, {shown}/{total} constraints.
assembly.同じ群の突起とくぼみが一緒に変わる: Bumps and recesses in one family change together
assembly.元の子・親の接触集合と同じです。: The original child and parent contact sets are preserved.
assembly.元の子・親の接触集合から変わりました。: The child or parent contact set differs from the original.
assembly.置換が要求する条件だけで、すべて合います。: All matches follow from the substitution constraints.
assembly.各マスは、群の間で追加で比べる深さの条件です。同じ条件の重複はまとめています。: Each square is an additional depth condition between families. Repeated conditions are shown once.
assembly.両方で合う{both}、親だけ合う{extra}、子だけ合う{lost}。: {both} match at both scales; {extra} only as parents; {lost} only as children.
assembly.親の判定は「3 · 親にまとめる」で開きます。: Reveal the parent results in “3 · Form a parent”.
assembly.線の表示は説明用です。設計の深さを変えるのは次の段階です。: Revealing edges explains the constraints. The next step changes the actual depths.
